basics.label: Basics
basics.description: What you are selling, in your words — and what it costs.

stock.label: Stock
stock.description: Unlimited by default. Track it to stop overselling and show buyers sold-out and “Only N left” badges. The alert number is when that second badge appears. The order limit is separate: it caps how many one buyer can take at once, tracked or not.

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.description: Written once for your whole store, not per product. Pick a profile only if this one ships differently.

options.label: Options
options.description: Colours, sizes, power outputs — however this product varies. Buyers pick one of each.

photos.label: Photos
photos.description: More angles for the product page. Drop photos onto an option to show them only for it.

specs.label: Specifications
specs.description: Dimensions, materials and specifications for the product page.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Certificates, manuals, or spec sheets buyers and regulators can check before buying.

safety.label: Safety and compliance
safety.description: Who made it and how to reach them. EU product-safety law asks for this on physical goods.
safety.about: What Safety and compliance is for

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.description: Active is live: buyers can see it and buy it right away. Draft is hidden from buyers until you switch it.

badges.label: Badges
badges.description: A few words on the product page: a reason to trust you, or a fact worth seeing at a glance. Pick a ready-made one or write your own, give its icon a colour, and put it beside the product or on the photo.

statement.title: Statement of reasons
statement.subtitle: {action, select, paused {We paused your {target, select, product {product} other {storefront}}} other {We removed your {target, select, product {product} other {storefront}}}}
statement.intro: This statement explains a decision we took about content you published on SquareShare, why we took it, and how you can challenge it. You are entitled to it under Article 17 of the EU Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065).

decision.paused: Paused. The content is hidden from buyers until you make the changes listed below and we approve them.
decision.removed: Removed. The content is no longer available to buyers. This decision is final unless an appeal changes it.
decision.pausedAutomated: Paused. The content is hidden from buyers until you change it. It is checked again as soon as you save a change.

statement.scope: Everywhere SquareShare shows it: its own page, embeds on other websites and shared links, in every country.

duration.pausedAutomated: Until you change it and the change passes the check.

status.reversed: Reversed. The content is visible to buyers again.
status.deleted: The content has since been deleted.

facts.notices: {count, plural, =0 {We found this ourselves, without a notice from anyone outside SquareShare.} one {This followed # notice from someone outside SquareShare, about: {reasons}.} other {This followed # notices from people outside SquareShare, about: {reasons}.}}
facts.review: A member of SquareShare staff reviewed the content itself before deciding. We do not share who sent a notice.
facts.automated: Our automatic check found this when the content was saved. Nobody outside SquareShare reported it, and no member of staff has reviewed it.

statement.automated: No automated means were used to detect this content or to take this decision.

legalBasis.contract: Contractual: the SquareShare Terms of Service, which do not allow content like this ({url}).
legalBasis.illegal: Legal: we considered the content illegal under the law that applies to it.

statement.fixIntro: {target, select, product {Change these parts, then press "I've made the changes" on the product in your dashboard, and we will look again:} other {Change these parts, then press "I've made the changes" on the storefront in your dashboard, and we will look again:}}

redress.settlement: Out-of-court dispute settlement: you may take this decision to a dispute settlement body certified under Article 21 of the Digital Services Act.
redress.court: Courts: you may take this decision to a competent court. Using the options above does not affect that right.
redress.contact: Questions: write to {email} and quote reference {reference}.

appeal.open: You appealed on {date}. A person is reviewing it.

appeal.overturned: You appealed on {date}. We answered on {decided}: the decision was reversed.

statement.automatedYes: Automated means were used both to detect this content and to take this decision, and no person was involved. If you appeal, a member of staff reviews it.
